note: Wooded Christian family campground on Lady Slipper Ln in Winthrop (Kennebec Co); campers' beach, docks and blow-up water park on Lower Narrows Pond at the end of a foot path from the sites. Drug- and alcohol-free, with posted dress rules guests sign at check-in. --Claude
summary: Rates, season, site types confirmed from the operator; added season, weekend minimum, phone booking, dump, laundry, store. Mostly seasonal on its own map: flagged.
flags: MOSTLY SEASONAL, drop question for AWH: the operator's site map colours about 50 of about 70 numbered sites green 'Seasonal Site' and only about 16 orange 'Camper Site $50' (15-18, 2, 3, 7, 43, 44, 46-49, 23, 25, 67, counted off the map image), about 23% nightly. That passes long-stay test 4 (1 in 10) and a nightly rate is posted, so test 2 passes. I read it as mostly seasonal. Map shows no separate $55 full-hookup colour although the rate page sells one. The site map is undated.

PRIVATE GATE: base $50 is exactly on the line, before 9% tax; full hookup $55. I read it as borderline in price. No gateway within 40 km (Acadia 135 km). Presence passes: working site, phone 207-395-4908. Booking by phone or Facebook message only, no engine. Google 4.5 over 88 (Maps panel, read, name 'More To Life Family Campground'). The Dyrt 4.3 over 6 and Campendium no reviews, from search snippets, pages not opened. RV Life has no tier. Nothing under 4.0.

POLICIES (borderline rule, AWH 2026-10-31), quoted: 'We reserve the right to select our clientele and guests. Those not meeting the standard of dress or conduct will be asked to leave without any refund.' 'This is a drug, and alcohol-free campground.' 'All adult check in guest on the reservation must sign our rules and regulations.' 'A Christian Based Camping Experience.' Rates page: 'We do not give any refunds on deposits.' Taken with the mostly seasonal map and the $50 base, this is the on-the-fence case; I didn't read any review text, so no complaint is quoted.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront holds. Operator's map puts the beach, docks and water park on Lower Narrows Pond at the end of Loon Lane/Boat Cove Lane foot paths, well away from every numbered site; imagery shows the sites in forest about 300 m east of the pond's south tip. The beach is day use in any case.
Pin at the store and sites: fine. Website and phone are the operator's. Electric amperage is not stated anywhere, so electric stays unset.
